searchText: why do you need a file at all for now? you can literally set a single flag like `--builder.urls` on the vc and I suggest every client adds such a flag so users can easily configure this without have to deal with deeply nested file configs, we wanna standardize configuration on the keymanager api first here https://github.com/ethereum/keymanager-APIs/pull/88 but also I think it would be good to have a standard interchange format for the config file per my comment [here](https://github.com/ethereum/keymanager-APIs/pull/87#issuecomment-5080931147), at this point, the spec is in a good shape, just needs more eyes to be mergable. for now the prs that need more eyes are - https://github.com/ethereum/keymanager-APIs/pull/88 - https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/630 - https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/165 it would be good if someone can implement this e2e to make sure we didn't miss anything, otherwise, I can probably also find time next week, we should aim to get those merged in 1-2 weeks, but nothing is blocking us from implementing and testing these already, instead of hacking your own stuff it would be more helpful if we get implementation feedback on the spec. cc <@641548687813902336> <@363800010518822915>

excerpts.content:
why do you need a file at all for now? you can literally set a single flag like `--builder.urls` on the vc and I suggest every client adds such a flag so users can easily configure this without have to deal with deeply nested file configs, we wanna standardize configuration on the keymanager api first here https://github.com/ethereum/keymanager-APIs/pull/88 but also I think it would be good to have a standard interchange format for the config file per my comment [here](https://github.com/ethereum/keymanager-APIs/pull/87#issuecomment-5080931147), at this point, the spec is in a good shape, just needs more eyes to be mergable.

for now the prs that need more eyes are
- https://github.com/ethereum/keymanager-APIs/pull/88
- https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/630
- https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/165

it would be good if someone can implement this e2e to make sure we didn't miss anything, otherwise, I can probably also find time next week, we should aim to get those merged in 1-2 weeks, but nothing is blocking us from implementing and testing these already, instead of hacking your own stuff it would be more helpful if we get implementation feedback on the spec. cc <@641548687813902336> <@363800010518822915>
